title: The initial SSE state snapshot on GET /api/events exceeds 8 MB, paid on every UI or observer connect
outcome: Connecting to the event stream costs a bounded, small initial payload. Full session transcripts are fetched on demand, not pushed whole in the first frame.
acceptance: A measurement note records the initial snapshot's size broken down by component, and the state-lock hold time while it's built, on a host with the current session count.

The initial snapshot excludes or bounds the large components (for example by omitting message bodies beyond a recent window, with lazy fetch through existing endpoints), and the UI still renders and refreshes sessions correctly; covered by tests.
With the same session set, the initial frame is at most 1 MB (or a documented bound agreed by the coordinator), and cargo test --bin termal plus the UI vitest suite are green.
